decks.name: Wailord / Indeedee wall
decks.note: Wailord and Indeedee ex soak damage while Heavy Helmet, Lucky Ice Pop and Soothing Shore keep healing.

decks.name: Mega Blaziken tournament list
decks.note: Torchic into Mega Blaziken ex with Rare Candy, Flame Patch and a Rocky Helmet.

decks.name: Mega Manectric / Heliolisk
decks.note: Mega Manectric ex hits harder for every point you have; Heliolisk and Clemont's Backpack add Lightning damage.

decks.name: Alolan Ninetales / Raticate
decks.note: Alolan Ninetales ex's Binding Snow keeps their Energy off the Active; Team Rocket's Raticate ex steals one when it evolves.

decks.name: Brew 7: Hoopa / Darkrai / Sableye
decks.note: Hoopa ex, Darkrai ex and Mega Sableye ex with Deceptive Needle, Lucky Ice Pop and Starting Plains.

decks.name: Draft A: Shark Tempo
decks.note: Mega Sharpedo ex hits for one Water Energy and arms the Bench every turn; Alolan Ninetales ex denies their Energy.

decks.name: Draft B: Tide Heal
decks.note: SET ASIDE (Oct 2): it met its own stopping condition, 34 wins of 240 against Lucario (14%), under its 30% line. Kept, not to be played. No Pokémon ex. Starmie and Milotic hit for 60 and the deck heals every turn.

decks.name: Draft C: Meowstic / Hatterene v2
decks.note: Brew 5b with the fixes from his own notes: Meowstic confuses, retreats, and Hatterene hits for 140.

decks.name: Draft D: Entei / Grimhound
decks.note: Entei ex tempo, Magby's free Energy, and Mega Houndoom ex's three coins with Victory Star. Amended Oct 2: one Mega Houndoom ex (he owns one), and a Copycat in place of the second to find it.
